machine_end_gcode:
M117 Finishing print
G1 E-2.5 F2100 ; Retract filament
G92 E0.0
G91 ;setze auf relative Positionierung
G1 E-3 F1800 ;Filament zurückziehen
G1 Z10 F9000 ; Z-Achse 10mm hoch
G90 ;setze auf absolute Positionierung
;G1{if max_layer_z < printable_height} Z{z_offset+min(max_layer_z+30, printable_height+0.2)}{endif} E-1.5 F720 ; Retract and raise Z
G4 ; wait
G28 X0 ; home X axis
M104 S0 ; Cooldown hotend
M140 S0 ; Cooldown bed
M106 S0 ; turn off cooling fan
M107 ; off fan
;MG1 X0 Y100 F3000 ; park print head
G1 X-5 Y320 F3000 ; bring bed forward
G1 Z0
M84 ; disable motors
M117 Print finished
machine_start_gcode:
;Geeetech official wiki homepage for A30：https://www.geeetech.com/wiki/index.php/Geeetech_A30_3D_Printer 
M117 Preparing....   
M104 S[first_layer_temperature] ; set extruder temp
M140 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; set bed temp
M190 S[first_layer_bed_temperature] ; wait for bed temp
M109 S[first_layer_temperature] ; wait for extruder temp
M220 S100 ;Reset Feedrate
M221 S100 ;Reset Flowrate
G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
G28 ; Home all axes
M107 ;Off Fan
G1 Z5.0 F3000 ;Move Z Axis up little to prevent scratching of Heat Bed
G1 X0.1 Y20 Z1.4 F6000 ; Move to start position
G1 X0.1 Y80.0 Z1.4 F1000 E25 ; Draw the first line
G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
G1 X0.4 Y80.0 Z1.4 F6000 ; Move to side a little
G1 X1.4 Y20 Z1.4 F1000 E20 ; Draw the second line
G92 E0 ; Reset Extruder
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Move Z Axis up little to prevent scratching of Heat Bed
G1 X5 Y20 Z0.28 F3000.0 ; Move over to prevent blob squish
;
; second purge lines, longer
G92 E0                ; Zero extruder
G28                   ; Home X/Y/Z axis
G1 Z0; Duese senken als Vorbereitung fuer das Material abstreifen
G1 Z0.2; Duese etwas anheben fuer Material Vorlauf
G0 X15 Z0.1 F9000      ; Move up 0.1mm
G0 Y10 F500           ; Move 10mm to get rid of material
G0 Z1 F9000           ; Move up
G0 Y45 F9000         ; Move to line start
G0 Z0.28 F9000         ; Move down
G1 Y225 E15 F1500       ; Extrude 15mm filament over 180mm Y axis
G1 X15.3 Y225.0 Z0.28 F5000.0 ; Move to side a little
G1 Y45 Z0.28 F1500.0 E30 ; Draw the second line
G1 Y35 F500           ; Move 10mm without extracting
G92 E0.0 ; reset extruder distance position
G1 Z2.0 F3000 ; Move Z Axis up little to prevent scratching of Heat Bed
G1 E-3 F1400          ; Retract 3mm filament
G1 X17 Y45 Z0.3 F5000.0 ; Move over to prevent blob squish
;
G92 E0
G28
M117 Starting print ...
name: Geeetech A30 0.4 nozzle
printer_notes: modifiziert für alten A30 (nicht A30 pro)
